edits.old: Then the system answers 503 with nothing written and never falls back to a rule ID or a version of the code
edits.new:
Then the system answers 503 with nothing written and never falls back to a rule ID or a version of the code

  Scenario: AC10 Error answers of the provided operations (401, 403, 404)
    Given a caller sends a request to a provided operation without valid authentication, without the right or for another firm's instruction
    When the request is sent
    Then the system answers 401 without valid authentication, 403 without the right and 404 for another firm's instruction and writes nothing

  Scenario: AC11 A replay of a write with the same idempotency key
    Given a write with an idempotency key has already been committed
    When the write is replayed with the same key
    Then the system answers with the committed result and writes nothing new

  Scenario: AC12 A retried or timed-out activity
    Given the recordFieldWorkResult activity fails with a retryable error or does not finish inside its timeout
    When the activity is retried
    Then one result, one document set, one ledger entry, one record and one event exist and nothing is committed twice

  Scenario: AC13 A consumed call fails or does not answer
    Given a consumed call returns an error or does not answer
    When the submission is sent
    Then the transaction rolls back and nothing is committed

  Scenario: AC14 A status change the model does not allow is refused
    Given the status change is not allowed by the instruction status model
    When the status change is sent
    Then the system answers 409 and nothing is written
